notes: Known list r03.txt was empty. The three shows the brief names as covered elsewhere (Albany NY Show Promotions, PokeKon Rochester, Fanatics Fest NYC) were not researched. All 8 WebSearch calls used; 27 WebFetch calls used; no budget left unspent for leads that were reachable. Every recorded date was checked with date(1) against its stated weekday, and all matched. No phone numbers recorded. Not reachable (DNS failure or 404, not counted as blocked): the42ndstcardshow.com (the 42nd St card show organizer domain), thehofstrashow.com, thecityshow.com, nysfairgrounds collectorsfest-112, qc.event.cuny.edu/events. Long Island Sports Dome's own site lists no card shows, so South Shore Showdown stays a lead. South Shore Events' bare domain redirects to an unrelated coming soon page for a different business. Western NY records (Batavia, Lockport, Olean, Elmira, Sanborn, Depew, Elma, Lakeville, Niagara Falls, Lakewood, Blasdell, Williamsville) come from the Shake and Break 716 community calendar at sites.google.com/view/wnycardshows. That page has no date of its own, but its 2026 and 2027 entries carry years, so they are medium confidence. Batavia's 2026 Card & Collectibles listing and the 2027 Sports Card & Collectibles listing are recorded as one series; that is an inference from the same venue and format. The Collectorsfest #110 fairgrounds page and a separate listing for a Sept 13 fairgrounds sports card show look like one event; recorded once. The Collectors Mega Show #113 date and hours come from the fairgrounds venue page; the CNY Promotions site names the show and contact but shows no date, and an image file name there mentions a different December day, which was not used. Project TCG at Queens College comes only from the university calendar, so it has no organizer, admission or sells data; a listing for a Dec 20 Pokemon show at the same campus (10 am to 5 pm) is probably the same event but its hours were not used. Midtown's vendor email is a personal AOL address that the organizer publishes for vendors, recorded per rule 6. The Long Island TCG Show general contact address is not recorded as a vendor contact because it is not for vendors. Out of region and not recorded: Jersey City (NJ) Jan 17 2027, Lawrence Township (NJ) Feb 6 2027, Hasbrouck Heights (NJ), North East PA, Somers (CT) Aug 23 2026, Westchester IL Oct 31 2026. Albany area was not pursued per the brief.
